items.title: Nifty reclaims 23,000 as FIIs turn net buyers; rupee ends unchanged
items.description: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) snapped their nine-week selling streak, turning net buyers with equity purchases worth Rs 6,304.67 crore during the week.

items.title: RIL Q2 FY27: O2C business drives record performance
items.description: Consolidated revenues and EBIDTA grew 29 percent and 26 percent, respectively, driven by record performance by the O2C (Oil to Chemicals) division, supported by strong growth in Jio and the FMCG businesses

items.title: Block Deals: Tencent Holdings exits Swiggy for Rs 982 crore
items.description: Swiggy shares seem to have reacted to the block deals, falling 4.67 percent to end at Rs 176.6, near its record low levels. The fall was accompanied by above-average volumes.

items.title: Sagility promoter sells 12% stake for Rs 2,395 crore; Smallcap World Fund raises holding in Lotus Developers
items.description: On the other side, six domestic and global institutional investors collectively acquired a 5.19 percent stake in Sagility, worth Rs 1,039.32 crore.
